GOOD.meaning: Input passes the current gate; continue the real Recognition flow.
GOOD.result_policy: Do not display Image Quality recovery.

WARNING.meaning: A warning signal exists but classification may remain eligible according to the real gate output.
WARNING.result_policy: Do not route to Image Quality solely because the value is WARNING.

INVALID.meaning: Input is not classifier-eligible according to the real gate output.
INVALID.result_policy: Route NO_FISH first when reason is NO_FISH; otherwise use IMAGE_QUALITY_WARNING. Do not create a FishRecord.

quality_gate.precedence: QUALITY_GATE controls eligibility. A reason cannot override a GOOD/WARNING/INVALID value. NO_FISH has its own Result state.

IMAGE_QUALITY_GENERIC_FROZEN.title: 照片不够清晰，无法识别
IMAGE_QUALITY_GENERIC_FROZEN.body: 请拍摄更清晰的照片，确保鱼的整体轮廓清晰，没有遮挡
IMAGE_QUALITY_GENERIC_FROZEN.source_rule: Use exact existing Frozen wording and Recovery Panel; no reason-specific message, paraphrase or dynamic claim.

NO_FISH_FROZEN.title: 没有找到可识别的鱼
NO_FISH_FROZEN.body: 请让鱼完整出现在画面中，再试一次
NO_FISH_FROZEN.source_rule: No Fish copy/state stays separate from Image Quality.

reason_taxonomy.emission_rule: Only emit when the upstream quality source has measured low-light evidence; otherwise do not diagnose.
reason_taxonomy.display_condition: Only when quality=INVALID and Result state=IMAGE_QUALITY_WARNING; no reason-specific text.

reason_taxonomy.emission_rule: Only emit when the upstream quality source has measured blur evidence; otherwise do not diagnose.
reason_taxonomy.display_condition: Only when quality=INVALID and Result state=IMAGE_QUALITY_WARNING; no reason-specific text.

reason_taxonomy.emission_rule: Use only for a true no-eligible-fish outcome.
reason_taxonomy.display_condition: Always the separate NO_FISH recovery; never Image Quality.

reason_taxonomy.emission_rule: Use only for a real multi-fish signal.
reason_taxonomy.result_state: Recognition outcome follows actual classifier eligibility; no Image Quality recovery solely from this reason.
reason_taxonomy.display_condition: No new reason-specific copy or page; preserve existing Result behavior.

reason_taxonomy.emission_rule: Use only when the current size/geometry gate emits a measured small-subject reason.
reason_taxonomy.display_condition: Use exact generic Frozen Recovery copy; do not claim blur or measured optical quality.

reason_taxonomy.emission_rule: Only emit when the upstream quality source has measured angle evidence; otherwise do not diagnose.
reason_taxonomy.display_condition: Only when quality=INVALID and Result state=IMAGE_QUALITY_WARNING; no reason-specific text.

display_invariants: The UI resolves copy through this registry and uses exact existing Frozen wording.
No custom Android copy, paraphrase, reason-specific diagnosis or Frozen PNG modification is authorized.
Unmeasured LOW_LIGHT, BLUR or BAD_ANGLE must not be emitted or asserted.
Image Quality and No Fish remain distinct; Technical Failure uses neither recovery copy.
